examples.trans: I will gladly help you out today.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'верять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to check, test, verify', paired with 'проверить'.

examples.text: Сегодня я проверяю ваш новый ресторан.
examples.trans: Today I am inspecting your new restaurant.

examples.text: Он нас проверяет.
examples.trans: He is testing us.

examples.text: Учитель проверяет тетради.
examples.trans: The teacher is checking notebooks.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'your, yours (polite or plural)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Моя будущая жена ваша большая поклонница.
examples.trans: My future wife is a big admirer of yours.

examples.text: Я хотел купить одно из ваших платьев.
examples.trans: I wanted to buy one of your dresses.

examples.text: Она мечтала петь именно в вашем платье.
examples.trans: She dreamed of singing in your dress specifically.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('new').

examples.text: Надо придумать, где установить большой подиум.
examples.trans: We need to figure out where to set up the big runway.

examples.text: Россия для него совсем новый рынок.
examples.trans: Russia is a brand-new market for him.

examples.text: Боится, что не влезем в новую коллекцию.
examples.trans: He is afraid we will not fit into the new collection.

meanings.note: Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.text: Будешь красиво на работу в ресторан ходить.
examples.trans: You will walk to work at the restaurant looking beautiful.

examples.text: Здравствуйте, буду рад видеть вас в ресторане.
examples.trans: Hello, I will be glad to see you in the restaurant.

examples.text: Наш ресторан претендует на высокую награду.
examples.trans: Our restaurant is a contender for a high award.
